release.name: v0.1.2
release.headline: PTv3 multi-head with single frame 4 channel voxels and no velocity head, trained in three stages like v0.1.1: a segmentation encoder stage, pretraining on the pseudo labelled corpora with JPN taxi gen2 as the only taxi data, then joint training on the 10 Hz pseudo labels with the Kognic pre-delivery ground truth. On both sets comparable with v0.1.1 it lands close but slightly below: seg3d mIoU 0.746 against 0.758, lost almost entirely on the debris and noise classes, and det3d mAP 0.535 against 0.542, behind on bicycle, pedestrian, truck and car and ahead on traffic cone, barrier and motorcycle.

model: Single frame input: the encoder voxelizes the current lidar frame alone into 4 point channels, where v0.1.1 added 1 past sweep and voxelized both into 11 channels including a time lag channel. The detection head no longer predicts velocity
The z range is -2.30 to 5.38 m, 7.68 m in 0.12 m voxels, so the 64 height cells halve evenly at every pooling stage of the encoder. v0.1.1 used -3.0 to 5.0 m

Three training stages as in v0.1.1: a segmentation only encoder stage on the j6gen2 semantic corpus, then 24 epochs on the pseudo labelled J6 gen2, large bus and JPN taxi gen2 corpora with the j6gen2 semantic corpus repeated 6 times, then 10 epochs of joint training on the 10 Hz pseudo labelled corpus of the J6 gen2, large bus and JPN taxi gen2 releases with the Kognic pre-delivery joint ground truth repeated 6 times per epoch

Against v0.1.1 the base stage drops the JPN taxi gen1 releases db_jpntaxi_v1, v2 and v4, and the joint stage trains on the Kognic ground truth instead of the 7 scene joint set repeated 15 times. db_jpntaxi_v1 stays out of the 10 Hz corpus too, since its lidar packs name their frames inconsistently, and 2 Kognic scenes without box annotation are left out
The base stage trains on 8 H200 and the joint stage on 16 H200 with the v0.1.1 joint schedule, 2 warmup and 8 decay epochs, and the learning rates scaled by the square root of the batch growth, x1.41

The release checkpoint is the last epoch of the joint stage. The lowest validation loss came at the learning rate peak in epoch 2, and that checkpoint matches it in det3d mAP but trails by 0.008 in mAPH and by 0.025 in joint set seg3d mIoU

The deployed graphs change their interface: the encoder takes 4 channel voxels, the encoder and the seg3d head take precomputed attention patch orders (patch_order inputs) in place of the serialized orders, and the det3d head no longer outputs vel
test: The seg3d set is unchanged, 465 frames of 17 scenes, and is directly comparable with v0.1.1

The det3d set is unchanged, 5910 frames of 244 scenes scored on detection alone, with the same ground truth and metric parameters as v0.1.1. Without a velocity head every matched box scores the worst velocity error, so NDS and mAVE drop by construction and mAP is the number to compare

The joint set is new, 288 frames of 14 scenes with box and point ground truth from the Kognic pre-delivery annotation. The earlier joint set is retired, as 6 of its 7 scenes are now in the training split and the last one in validation
